messages:
sarah_partnerships: Hey team — quick sync: EdgeBank wants to kick off a joint POC next week. Primary asks: SAML SSO, customer KMS, 6-month committed pricing, and confirmation we can run Private in their VPC. Can we confirm owners?
sarah_partnerships: They also flagged the security questionnaire item about data residency and audit retention. I'm collating answers but need technical bits.
jordan_eng: We can provision a Private instance in us-east-1 within their VPC. Need their subnet/CIDR and an accept of the infra playbook. Will take lead on infra.
tariq_se: I'll own the security questionnaire responses. EdgeBank asked about KMS/HSM and log retention. Short answers: customer-managed AWS KMS supported, HSM via partner integrations, audit logs exportable to their S3 for 365 days. I'll paste the exact wording shortly.
luis_sales: Pricing question from EdgeBank: they want committed pricing for 6 months + reserved capacity. What numbers should I give them for a baseline 40M tokens/month? cc @elaine_pm
elaine_pm: For a 6-month reserved package we typically do a committed capacity contract. Rough baseline: $Xk/month for 4 GPUs equivalent (A100-ish) with a 15-25% discount compared to pay-as-you-go hosted. I'll run an infra sizing with jordan and give you two options (conservative / aggressive).
maria_legal: EdgeBank legal also requested our SOC2 and recent pen test summary. I uploaded SOC2 and pen-test exec summary to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/sr/edgebank/compliance (read-only link).
devops-bot: deploy:private-trial-us-east-1 started by jordan_eng at 2026-05-12T09:12:03Z
jordan_eng: Also noting a potential blocker: their infra team requires mutual TLS between our control-plane connector and their VPC. That requires a short CFN change and cert exchange. Est ~2 days.
tariq_se: Security Qs I need from EdgeBank to finish the questionnaire: 1) KMS CMK ARN for test environment 2) List of IPs allowed to call management API 3) Expected retention window for logs (they asked 2 vs 365 days). Can someone confirm we'll accept 365 for POC?
sarah_partnerships: I asked them to confirm 365. EdgeBank ops prefers 90 but legal will push for 365. We'll propose 90 for trial, 365 for production.
luis_sales: They also asked about model fallback during latency spikes — they need a canary/fallback policy so customer-facing apps don't fail. Is that supported?
jordan_eng: Yes — runtime supports model-variant fallback and route policies. Example policy we've used for other banks:

```
route_policy:
  primary: redwood-dedicated-v1
  fallback: redwood-llama-small
  latency_slo_ms: 250
  retry: 1
```

We can demo this in the POC.
tariq_se: I'll attach the exact KMS/HSM wording for the questionnaire. Also need to confirm whether audit logs contain token-level metadata (we have token-level cost/latency but don't log full prompt text unless configured). EdgeBank legal care about PII — we should state that prompt/response logging is opt-in and can be disabled in Private.
maria_legal: Confirmed. Add: "Prompt/response logging is disabled by default for Private deployments; when enabled it can be routed to customer-controlled S3 with encryption and restricted IAM." I'll prepare a short paragraph they can include in their questionnaire.
elaine_pm: Next steps: jordan to size infra and estimate costs (end of day Wednesday), tariq to post security questionnaire draft (tomorrow), maria to share SOC2 + pen-test link, luis to draft the commercial term sheet with two pricing tiers.
sarah_partnerships: Can we schedule a joint enablement/demo with EdgeBank next Wed 10am ET? They want a walkthrough of fallbacks, SSO, and the console.
jordan_eng: Free then. I'll prepare a short demo script and a sandbox token.
luis_sales: I'll get the invite out. Also, EdgeBank asked if we can do a 30-day canary of reserved capacity before committing to 6 months — doable?
elaine_pm: We can support a 30-day pilot with a short reserved commit and option to convert. Finance needs to sign off but it's a standard play.
sarah_partnerships: Great — thanks everyone. I'll respond to EdgeBank with the plan and owners. If anyone needs to add blockers please drop them here. :thumbsup:
